_comment: Coop-test presets. Run: TMC_COOP_TEST=<name> ./tmc_pc. warp = area,room,x,y,layer (room-relative pixels, 0x-hex ok; layer 1 = bottom, 2 = top). all_items / mid_game_flags default to true.

presets.name: enemies
presets.description: Deepwood Shrine, Pillars room: six Sluggulas around the pillars. Combat, hit/knockback, enemy aggro.

presets.name: buttons
presets.description: Deepwood Shrine, Button room: a floor button next to Link. Stepping on / off it.

presets.name: push
presets.description: Deepwood Shrine, Double Statue room: pushable statue blocks around a floor plate. Pushing / pulling objects.

presets.name: transition
presets.description: Deepwood Shrine, Mulldozer room: Link stands at the open south doorway. Walk down into the Pillars room (room-to-room transition).

presets.name: portal
presets.description: Western Woods South (Hyrule Field): Link just below a Minish portal stump. Walk up onto it and press R to shrink.

presets.name: npc
presets.description: Link's house, ground floor: Smith is in the room. Walk up and talk (A / R) to open a dialogue.
